decisions.reason: The premium raisin stollen won gold from the Deutsches Brotinstitut in two consecutive years and is the firm's flagship, so its option has resolved favorably and seasonal production costs little.

The dark barley malt rye bread is the only survivor of the three new breads, which suggests it sells adequately, and with the bread portfolio pruned the firm holds few alternative options while keeping it costs little in an existing rye line.

The marzipan stollen is still shown on its own page in 2024 and shares seasonal production with the award-winning stollen line, so it is cheap to carry and complements the flagship, with no sign its value has failed.
